basis: Three user-supplied launch-report photos and user's description; no direct device access
user_report: File-source Infuse has slow startup and stops again after a short period of playback; user requests an alternative to the direct file
confirmed_findings: The new attempts already select the hls2 field, not the normal Infuse http field
Plugin-side preparation is 0-1 ms and dispatch is 0 ms at the report clock resolution
The exact selected address is unchanged at the plugin boundary
The handoff is one video with no reported resume position
These timings do not measure application opening, media access, first frame or playback stability
hls2 is a KinoPub delivery field; it does not mean transport without HTTP(S), and mp4 is only an extension hint
remaining_hypotheses: Infuse compatibility with the actual HLS response; an authenticated response is needed
Redirect, expired-address or server error response; capture status, type and redirect chain
For file-source stalls separately: partial reads, source/network interruptions or Infuse cache behavior; no cause established

next_control.scope: Ordinary file-source Infuse playback, not the failed HLS2 comparison
next_control.change: If cache is Auto, compare Memory Only with original setting; keep title, file choice, 1080p, network and launch/resume position fixed
next_control.measure: Manual time to first frame; watch beyond the previous stop point for 5-10 minutes; record elapsed playback time and media position if it stops
next_control.limits: A different cache setting is a hypothesis test, not a promised fix; plugin API does not expose this setting

decision: Do not force HLS2 as an alleged fix or invent another transport; retain explicit comparison and separate stall diagnosis from startup
